## A section heading describing the trend over time

Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore.
The chart below uses **synthetic placeholder data**, not real regional figures.

```{r}
#| label: fig-line
#| fig-cap: "A caption describing what this line chart would show"
set.seed(1)
line_df <- data.frame(
  index = 1:12,
  value = cumsum(c(20, rnorm(11, mean = 4, sd = 6)))  # synthetic series — not real data
)

plot_ly(line_df, x = ~index, y = ~value,
        type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
        line = list(color = accent_dark, width = 3),
        marker = list(color = accent_dark, size = 7)) |>
  zola_style(ytitle = "A measured value", xtitle = "Time period")
```

## A section heading comparing categories

**synthetic placeholder data**.

```{r}
#| label: fig-bar
#| fig-cap: "A caption describing what this bar chart would show"
bar_df <- data.frame(
  category = factor(c("Category A", "Category B", "Category C",
                      "Category D", "Category E"),
                    levels = c("Category A", "Category B", "Category C",
                               "Category D", "Category E")),
  value = c(38, 52, 29, 47, 33)  # synthetic values — not real data
)

plot_ly(bar_df, x = ~category, y = ~value, type = "bar",
        marker = list(color = accent_dark)) |>
  zola_style(ytitle = "A measured value", xtitle = "")
```
